notes: Commit d8f983a on bridgie-task/statement-review/T10. Feature events come from their own RNG, added after every draw of the existing RNG and only when features are given; truth fields added for features are left out of the truth JSON when there are none, so existing truth files are byte-identical too. Feature truth is for v2 with the generated case profile (the only table that knows real acquirers and cash); under features the existing capital-introduced line's truth is director_funding, as v2 gives it. I did not change it for unfeatured truth: the design's Migration says it becomes director_funding there, but that belongs with making v2 the default and would break the byte-identical truth files and test_categoriser_matches_truth under the v1 default. The second account is checked as its own statement with the profile naming each account's transfers; own-account pairing (R8) is Tier 2 and not built, so P17 does not claim pairs. The indicator truth restates the shipped thresholds in synth.TRUTH_THRESHOLDS rather than reading the module it checks. Already there before this change: for statements shorter than a full VAT quarter (months 1-3) truth.late_vat_count is 0 while M13 is n/a, with or without features; the evals and tests use 6+ months.
